description: Exports rendered image assets from one or more elements by canonical id or selector.

pageId.description: Page ID containing the target image elements.

selector.description: CSS selector for a target element in the main frame.

items.description: DOM query target identified by either canonical id or selector.

targets.description: Targets to export, preserving input order in response.data.items.

path.description: Required output directory. Every successful image item is written to this directory with an automatic filename.

format.description: Response payload format. Successful images are always written to options.path; base64/dataUrl additionally include inline data.

imageFormat.description: Preferred image encoding. auto keeps PNG/JPEG/WebP sources in the same encoding when possible and encodes other source formats as PNG.

quality.description: Quality for lossy encodings such as JPEG or WebP.

options.description: Required output options. path is an output directory, not a file path.

purpose.description: Describe why these image files are needed, e.g., saving product thumbnails, collecting visual assets, or preserving image evidence

purposeHint: Describe why these image files are needed, e.g., saving product thumbnails, collecting visual assets, or preserving image evidence
